Published GPS coordinates for the Mt Wilhelm study sites

geo_example_sites.Rd

Returns one row per elevation band of the Mt Wilhelm ant survey (tidydiversity::png_ants), with WGS84 longitude and latitude averaged from the bait GPS positions published by Mottl, Moses and Klimes (2023). These are real field coordinates; see png_ants_sites for the two transects per band.

Usage

geo_example_sites(which = "wilhelm")

Source

Mottl, O., Moses, J. and Klimes, P. (2023). Zenodo. doi:10.5281/zenodo.8191946

Arguments

which

Study area. Only "wilhelm" (the eight elevation bands from 200 to 3700 m) is available: the package has no published coordinates for other areas, so none are invented.

Value

A tibble with site, lon, lat, elevation (nominal band in metres), elevation_band (ordered factor) and coordinate_note.

Examples

geo_example_sites()
#> # A tibble: 8 × 6
#>   site     lon   lat elevation elevation_band coordinate_note                   
#>   <chr>  <dbl> <dbl>     <int> <fct>          <chr>                             
#> 1 MW0200  145. -5.74       200 200 m          published bait GPS, doi:10.5281/z…
#> 2 MW0700  145. -5.73       700 700 m          published bait GPS, doi:10.5281/z…
#> 3 MW1200  145. -5.72      1200 1200 m         published bait GPS, doi:10.5281/z…
#> 4 MW1700  145. -5.76      1700 1700 m         published bait GPS, doi:10.5281/z…
#> 5 MW2200  145. -5.76      2200 2200 m         published bait GPS, doi:10.5281/z…
#> 6 MW2700  145. -5.81      2700 2700 m         published bait GPS, doi:10.5281/z…
#> 7 MW3200  145. -5.80      3200 3200 m         published bait GPS, doi:10.5281/z…
#> 8 MW3700  145. -5.78      3700 3700 m         published bait GPS, doi:10.5281/z…
